div.div:
Solid = started by make up · dashed = optional, not in the default path. Blue = charging site · green = generation site · purple = microgrid · navy = OpenTelemetry Collector · amber = impaired WAN.
poll = the poller is the Modbus master: it requests and the meter answers — devices never push. The edge collector is the site's only egress and stamps energy.site.id, energy.site.kind and geo.latitude/longitude on every signal, so the map needs no knowledge of the sites.
